name: VigIA de SeoNova
changelog:
Fixed

  • Your own site visiting itself (the WP Rocket preloader and WordPress internal calls) was counted as HUMAN visits. It no longer is.
  • Bots whose name ends in "Bot" glued to another word (YouBot, Amzn-SearchBot) and names with an underscore (peer39_crawler) were counted as people. They are detected now.
  • Seven crawlers show their real name instead of a cut URL or "Mozilla": YouBot, Amazon SearchBot, Sogou, Peer39, Proximic, HubSpot and SofyaBot.
changelog_es:
Arreglado

  • Tu propia web visitandose a si misma (el precargador de WP Rocket y las llamadas internas de WordPress) se contaba como visitas de PERSONAS. Ya no se cuenta.
  • Los bots cuyo nombre acaba en "Bot" pegado a otra palabra (YouBot, Amzn-SearchBot) y los que llevan guion bajo (peer39_crawler) se contaban como personas. Ahora se detectan.
  • Siete rastreadores salen con su nombre de verdad en vez de una URL cortada o "Mozilla": YouBot, Amazon SearchBot, Sogou, Peer39, Proximic, HubSpot y SofyaBot.
